'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Howdy, I've got a nice little job for you. A guy came to me recently, says he used to know Reshala. Real high roller dude. Nice suit, signet ring the size of a bottle cap. I ran into him once before during a business dispute, think he drove a black BMW. He says war is war, but he still wants to decorate his place... his hideout, to be exact. Bring me as much jewelry and as many fancy trinkets as you can. I'll pass them along to him. Golden horse statues, cats, lions, anything like that will do. And see if you can find a gold Roler watch too. That'll be a little bonus. Trust me, brother, it's better to stay on good terms with people like him. Don't let me down, or it'll be bad for both of us.}}

==Objectives==
* Find 2 [[Bronze lion figurine]]s [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Find 2 [[Horse figurine]]s [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Find 2 [[Golden rooster figurine]]s [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Find 2 [[Cat figurine]]s [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Find 2 [[Roler Submariner gold wrist watch]]es [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Find 2 [[Golden egg]]s [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Hand over 2 [[Bronze lion figurine]]s to [[Ragman]]
* Hand over 2 [[Horse figurine]]s to [[Ragman]]
* Hand over 2 [[Golden rooster figurine]]s to [[Ragman]]
* Hand over 2 [[Cat figurine]]s to [[Ragman]]
* Hand over 2 [[Roler Submariner gold wrist watch]]es to [[Ragman]]
* Hand over 2 [[Golden egg]]s to [[Ragman]]

==Rewards==
* +28,000 [[EXP]]
* [[Ragman]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.75'''</font>
* 275,000 Roubles
** 288,750 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 316,250 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
{{quote|Thank you, brother. I'll pass everything along. Fine jewelry like this is always a welcome sight. I've got a feeling he's gonna like it.}}

The statues/figurines can commonly be found in the furniture displays throughout the store IDEA on [[Interchange]]. Alternatively, they, along with the [[Roler Submariner gold wrist watch]] and [[Golden egg]] can be found in [[Safe]]s. They can also be very rarely be found in other containers such as [[Drawer]]s, [[Sport bag]]s, [[Dead Scav]]s, and more.
